title: Design: long and special category names on Sales by Category
refs: SV-11718 (Reports Story 5 S5-R2 Reports Story 1 S1-R6 Reports Story 3 S3-R9)
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access', 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, with a long name with spaces of exactly 50 characters (for example Northern Alberta Heavy Equipment Fleet Pricing Tier).
  • Have a new category for this test, category B, with a long name with no spaces of exactly 50 characters (for example NorthernAlbertaHeavyEquipmentFleetPricingTierPlanX).
  • Have a new category for this test, category C, with a name with the characters & " ' < > in it (for example A&B "Fleet" O'Neil <Tier>).
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer D, left on Default for work orders and Part Sales.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer D, with one part in each of categories A, B and C, invoiced today.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales by Category.
  2. Pick customer D in the Customer filter.
  3. Open the Category filter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales by Category opens.

Step 2:

  • Category A's, category B's and category C's rows each keep their name inside their own row.
  • Category C shows character for character, & " ' < > included.
  • Every column stays visible and the page does not scroll sideways.

Step 3:

  • Each long name wraps or is shortened with "..." inside the list.
  • No name runs past the list's edge.
